message.simplemobs.howler.too_bright: Too bright - the Howler only wakes in the dark
message.simplemobs.howler.too_peaceful: Too peaceful - nothing answers the call
message.simplemobs.howler.wrong_dimensio: The call finds no echo here
message.simplemobs.disguise.no_room: No room to take this shape here
message.simplemobs.disguise.revealed: Your disguise falls - they have seen you
tip.simplemobs.trick_mirror: Hold use for 3 s: reveals disguises ahead
tip.simplemobs.deceiver_cloak: Wear it; empty hand on a mob takes its shape
tip.simplemobs.shellker_shell: Use on a Shulker to turn it into a Shellker
simplemobs.bossbar.title: %1$s - %2$s
jei.simplemobs.note.shellker_dress: Right-click a Shulker with the shell
jei.simplemobs.info.trick_mirror: No recipe. Hold use for 3 s to reveal up to 3 disguised fakes within 12 blocks (they glow for 2 s, 60 s cooldown). Only works when 'trickMirrorEnabled' is on in the Simple Mobs config (off by default); otherwise creative only.
jei.simplemobs.info.ender_parts: Ender Heart and Ender Gem have no source in normal play yet: they are the extra ingredients of the End Wings and Void Wings smithing recipes (creative tab and test centre only for now).
effect.simplemobs.volatile.description: A hit on the bearer sets off a small explosion that hurts everyone nearby except the bearer. Breaks no blocks.
effect.simplemobs.deflection.description: 10 % per level (up to 50 %) to negate a hit completely.
effect.simplemobs.mirror.description: Every hit is a coin flip: the bearer takes 120 % to 200 % damage, or the attacker takes 20 % to 100 % back (never lethal).
simplemobs.trials.wrong_key.evil: This vault only takes Evil Trial Keys.
simplemobs.trials.wrong_key.void: This vault only takes Void Trial Keys.
simplemobs.trials.turned.void: The trial falls into the void (Void Omen %s).
jei.simplemobs.trials.brew_note: Stage %s: the stage of the Ominous Bottle stays. 1-3 bottles below, the heart above, one heart per brew.
jei.simplemobs.trials.brew_fuel: Only in a Brewing Stand fuelled with Soulfire Powder: 1 powder = 20 soul charges, 1 charge per brew.
jei.simplemobs.trials.weathered.1: Weathered Trials are rare rooms underground: 9x9 (most), 13x13 (1 in 10) and a 19x19 cross (1 in 25).
jei.simplemobs.trials.weathered.2: The Weathered Trial Spawner works like the Vanilla one; the Weathered Vault gives its own loot.
jei.simplemobs.trials.weathered.3: A Trial Key from the spawner opens a normal vault, an Ominous Trial Key the ominous one (also Vanilla vaults).
jei.simplemobs.trials.weathered.4: Large rooms hold 2-4 spawners, 1 ominous and 3 normal vaults; the giant one up to 8 spawners, 2 ominous and 6 normal vaults.
jei.simplemobs.trials.evil_flow.1: 1. Brew an Evil Potion: Ominous Bottle + Nether Heart in a Brewing Stand fuelled with Soulfire Powder.
jei.simplemobs.trials.evil_flow.2: 2. Drink it: Evil Omen I-V (like Bad Omen, 100 minutes; it replaces Bad Omen).
jei.simplemobs.trials.evil_flow.3: 3. Enter a Weathered Trial: it turns evil. Mobs get more life (+10% per stage) and effects; the reward is the Evil Trial Key of that stage. In a village you start an Evil Raid instead.
jei.simplemobs.trials.evil_flow.4: 4. Turn a Weathered Vault into an Evil Vault (see Converting a vault) and open it with the key for the best loot.
jei.simplemobs.trials.void_flow.1: The Void chain is the Evil chain one tier up: Ender Heart instead of Nether Heart, netherite block instead of diamond block.
jei.simplemobs.trials.void_flow.2: It is off by default (config voidChain) until the Ender Heart has a source.
jei.simplemobs.trials.void_flow.3: Void Potion -> Void Omen -> Void Trial (stronger than Evil, one more effect step) -> Void Trial Key -> Void Vault.
jei.simplemobs.trials.void_flow.4: An Evil Vault becomes a Void Vault with a netherite block in the off hand and 5 strikes.
jei.simplemobs.trials.convert.1: Hold a diamond block in the off hand and strike a Weathered Vault 5 times with a hammer (an axe works without a hammer mod): it becomes an Evil Vault.
jei.simplemobs.trials.convert.2: Hold a netherite block in the off hand and strike an Evil Vault 5 times: it becomes a Void Vault (Void chain on).
jei.simplemobs.trials.convert.3: Only Weathered Vaults can be converted, never Vanilla vaults. The conversion cannot be undone.
jei.simplemobs.trials.convert.4: The Evil Vault takes only Evil Trial Keys (any stage, the loot follows the stage); the Void Vault only Void Trial Keys.
simplemobs.guide.page.1.title: Simple Mobs
simplemobs.guide.page.1: New bosses and mobs with fair, announced attacks, their drops, the Blighted Wither and the Biome Brush.
simplemobs.guide.page.2.title: Hollow Howler
simplemobs.guide.page.2: A Deep Dark boss you summon yourself: build the figure, blow a goat horn near a sculk sensor in the dark, and it manifests within 5 seconds.
simplemobs.guide.page.3.title: Potion of Silence
simplemobs.guide.page.3: Warped Potion (Awkward Potion without SimpleLib) + Echo Core: 3:00 of Silence (redstone 8:00, splash and lingering as usual). Sculk sensors, Wardens and Howlers do not hear you, like wool.
simplemobs.guide.page.4.title: Shellker
simplemobs.guide.page.4: An End gateway guard: a Shulker in a bedrock-hard shell. Four of them sit beside every End gateway, disguised as bedrock, until you come close.
simplemobs.guide.page.5.title: High Gravity and the Shellker Helmet
simplemobs.guide.page.5: High Gravity pulls you down: jumps, Levitation and Elytra lift keep 10 % and falls hurt 50 % more per level (Feather Falling still helps). The Shellker Helmet makes you immune.
simplemobs.guide.page.6.title: Combat effects: Volatile, Deflection, Mirror
simplemobs.guide.page.6: Three status effects, levels I-V, for mobs and players:
simplemobs.guide.page.7.title: Combat effects: Volatile, Deflection, Mirror
simplemobs.guide.page.7: Volatile answers hits with a small explosion, Deflection negates hits, Mirror flips a coin between more damage for the bearer and damage back to the attacker.
simplemobs.guide.page.8.title: Soulfire Blaze
simplemobs.guide.page.8: A Blaze of soul fire, found rarely in Soul Sand Valleys. Shoots volleys of soul fireballs and drops the Soulfire Rod.
simplemobs.guide.page.9.title: Deceiver: cloak, disguise, mirror
simplemobs.guide.page.9: From Deceiver Cloth: a cloak that lets you take any mob's or player's shape, a particle-free invisibility potion and a mirror that sees through deceptions.
simplemobs.guide.page.10.title: Deceiver: cloak, disguise, mirror
simplemobs.guide.page.10: The Deceiver itself has double life, takes the hit box of the mob it imitates and can double its summons.
simplemobs.guide.page.11.title: Dread
simplemobs.guide.page.11: A fear mob you build yourself: a 2.6 block knight of rusted armor with soul flames in its empty helmet and a chain mace. Its Shivering aura makes your aim waver; bright light weakens it.
simplemobs.guide.page.12.title: Hollow Watcher
simplemobs.guide.page.12: A 4 block shadow with many eyes on the outer End islands. It moves only while nobody looks at it; a spyglass look freezes it. Unwatched it teleports behind you and grips you.
simplemobs.guide.page.13.title: Shivering aura, Calm Amulet and Focus
simplemobs.guide.page.13: Near a fear mob you shiver: your aim wavers. Shivering I to V by distance (V under 4 blocks) while it looks at you or is triggered.
simplemobs.guide.page.14.title: Shivering aura, Calm Amulet and Focus
simplemobs.guide.page.14: The Calm Amulet or the Potion of Focus makes you immune.
simplemobs.guide.page.15.title: Blighted Wither, Nether Heart and Red Nether Gem
simplemobs.guide.page.16.title: Blighted Wither, Nether Heart and Red Nether Gem
simplemobs.guide.page.16: put a Netherite Helmet on the middle skull of the Wither figure before the third skull and the Blighted Wither rises - 600 health,
simplemobs.guide.page.17.title: Blighted Wither, Nether Heart and Red Nether Gem
simplemobs.guide.page.17: armor 8, three phases, and every special attack is announced before it
simplemobs.guide.page.18.title: Blighted Wither, Nether Heart and Red Nether Gem
simplemobs.guide.page.18: hits. An Enderite Helmet calls the even stronger Abyssal Wither. Both drop a Nether Heart, the Abyssal Wither also a Red Nether Gem.
simplemobs.guide.page.19.title: First pickup tips
simplemobs.guide.page.19: The first time you pick up a machine or tool whose use is not obvious, one short tip shows in the action bar - once per player and world.
simplemobs.guide.page.20.title: Creative tabs
simplemobs.guide.page.20: The module's items sit in its own creative tab only (no Vanilla tabs).
simplemobs.guide.page.21.title: Wither Wings
simplemobs.guide.page.21: Four Elytra stages that raise only the top speed a strong firework rocket reaches: x2 Wither, x4 Nether, x6 End and x8 Void Wings. Normal rockets and gliding without a rocket stay Vanilla.
simplemobs.guide.page.22.title: Strong Gunpowder, Strong Rocket, Strong TNT
simplemobs.guide.page.22: Strong Gunpowder (3 gunpowder + 1 blaze powder -> 1) makes strong rockets (paper + 1 Strong Gunpowder -> 3, flight duration 4) and Strong TNT (like TNT with Strong Gunpowder, explosion
simplemobs.guide.page.23.title: Strong Gunpowder, Strong Rocket, Strong TNT
simplemobs.guide.page.23: power 6 instead of 4). Vanilla gunpowder, TNT and rockets stay untouched.
simplemobs.guide.page.24.title: Commands
simplemobs.guide.page.24: /simplemobs config shows and changes every option of config/simplemobs-server.json (list [group], get, set, reset, help; Tab completes options and values).
simplemobs.guide.page.25.title: Commands
simplemobs.guide.page.25: Values are bounded like in the file, saved at once and take effect at once; options read only at start say so. Permission level 2.
simplemobs.guide.page.26.title: Commands
simplemobs.guide.page.26: /simpleclient simplemobs (list, get, set, reset, help) does the same for config/simplemobs-client.json on your own client.
simplemobs.guide.page.27.title: Weathered Trials
simplemobs.guide.page.27: Rare dungeon-like rooms underground with a Weathered Trial Spawner and Weathered Vaults - the Trial Chambers loop in verdigris copper, with their own loot.
simplemobs.guide.page.28.title: Evil Omen
simplemobs.guide.page.28: A stronger Bad Omen for Netherite-age players: brew the Evil Potion with a Nether Heart, drink it,
simplemobs.guide.page.29.title: Evil Omen
simplemobs.guide.page.29: turn a Weathered Trial or a village raid evil, win Evil Trial Keys and open an Evil Vault.
simplemobs.guide.page.30.title: Void chain
simplemobs.guide.page.30: The Evil chain one tier up - Void Potion, Void Omen, Void Trial, Void Vault - switched off by default until the Ender Heart has a source.
